notes.subject: tarangau
notes.rationale: נשר: 'tarangau' (eagle) o 'balus bilong kaiap' (vulture, JPS) — tupela i save long Tanakh.

notes.subject: ⟨Olsem wanem⟩
notes.rationale: אם em i askim bilong Hibru; Tok Pisin i nidim olgeta tok bilong askim.

notes.subject: bilong Yokap
notes.rationale: Askim dairek long Yokap — em i no inap wokim wanem tarangau i wokim.

translation: ⟨Olsem wanem⟩ long maut bilong yu tasol tarangau i save go het i go antap, na em i kirapim nest bilong en long ples hai?

tokens.gloss: i save go het i go antap
